basis: Design collaboration platform (New York); Tiger Global came in at the 2015 Series C, after the Accel/FirstMark early rounds; peaked near $1.9B (Series E 2018); announced Jan 2024 it would end its services by 31 Dec 2024 (Freehand sold to Miro; invisionapp.com now redirects to miro.com).

Beijing online-education services firm; its Nov 2008 6-K says Tiger Global was one of its Series B investors (Dec 2004) and the company bought Tiger's 14.5% back for ~$11M; Nasdaq IPO Dec 2007; going-private merger with a chairman-led buyer group completed 23 Apr 2014 at $7.00/ADS.
Engineering design software (renamed nTop), New York; Tiger Global led the $65M Series D (2021) after the Canaan-led B and Insight-led C; no priced valuation of $1B+ disclosed; still independent.

Scribe (scribehow), San Francisco workflow-documentation AI; Tiger Global led the $22M Series A (Oct 2021) after Amplify's $8M seed; $75M Series C led by StepStone at $1.3B post-money (Nov 2025, TechCrunch and company release).

Brazilian fintech giving Brazilians US accounts (São Paulo office; US entity Nomad Fintech Inc. in Orlando); Series A was Monashees/Spark (2021), Tiger Global led the $61M Series B (Aug 2023) at R$1.8B (~$361M); no later priced round found.
London payments processor; Tiger Global entered at the growth stage (led the $450M Series C at $15B, Jan 2021; in the $1B Series D at $40B, Jan 2022); Sept 2025 share buyback at ~$12B; no IPO.

Moscow e-commerce marketplace; Tiger Global was the first major institutional investor (~$5M, late 2009, after angel money), then followed on (2011, $30M in 2012); co-founder said in Dec 2016 the company no longer exists, site closed 2017 (ru.wikipedia).

Humanoid robotics (ex-Halodi Robotics, Norway), HQ Palo Alto; Tiger Global joined the $23.5M Series A2 led by OpenAI Startup Fund (Mar 2023); Series B $100M (Jan 2024) valuation undisclosed; a ~$10B raise was reported as sought in Sept 2025, no closed $1B+ round found.
Mohalla Tech (ShareChat/Moj), Bengaluru; Tiger Global co-led the ~$502M round at ~$2.1B (Apr 2021), after its Series A-E; last priced round $300M at $5B (2022, Google/Times/Temasek).

Beijing used-car platform; early money from Legend, DCM, Bertelsmann and Tencent, then Warburg Pincus and Tiger Global led a $260M round (2014); Nasdaq IPO June 2018 (UXIN); market cap ~$0.27B (Sept 2026).

Creator-business platform (terms give 400 Spectrum Center Dr, Irvine CA); Spectrum Equity took a minority stake in 2019, then Tiger Global led a $550M round at $2B (May 2021); no later priced round known.

Colombian merchant-payments fintech (bold.co); Tiger Global led the $55M Series B (Feb 2022) after a ~$10M earlier round; General Atlantic led a $50M Series C (Feb 2024) and a $40M round (Oct 2025), valuations undisclosed.
San Francisco observability-data company; Tiger Global came in at the 2021-22 growth rounds, not the Sequoia/CRV early rounds; $319M Series E at $3.5B (Aug 2024); no IPO found.

YC W21 e-commerce logistics startup (YC page: Buenos Aires, active); Tiger Global led the $25M Series A (May 2022) after ~$8M from Flexport, FundersClub, Vast VC; valuation undisclosed; site live in MX, CO, AR.
Marketplace headquartered in Brooklyn, New York City; Tiger Global came in via a late private round (c. 2010-2012), long after the USV/Accel Series A-D; IPO Apr 2015; market cap ~$6.3B (Sept 2026).
Momo Inc., now Hello Group (Nasdaq: MOMO), Beijing; Momo's F-1 shows Tiger Global Eight Holdings acquiring Series D preferred on 15 May 2014, before the Dec 2014 IPO; market cap ~$0.69B (Sept 2026).
AI model security startup, San Francisco; Tiger Global led the $30M Series B (Dec 2021) after Sequoia's Series A; acquired by Cisco (announced Aug 2024, closed Oct 2024).

Blockchain node infrastructure; privacy policy gives a Los Angeles address; Tiger Global led the $207M Series C at ~$3.25B (Jan 2022) after the 2021 Series A/B; still independent, no later priced round found.

Chennai digital freight forwarder; Tiger Global led the $36.3M Series A (Mar 2022), also in the SBI-led Rs 125 cr Series B (Jan 2024); The Loadstar (Sept 2025) reports bookings suspended and carrier credit pulled; wizfreight.com is now a placeholder page.
Palo Alto decentralized-clinical-trials software; Tiger Global came in at the 2020-21 growth rounds (Series C/D); $304M Series D led by Blackstone at $2.1B (Oct 2021); still independent.
African payments company headquartered in San Francisco (main operations Lagos); Tiger Global co-led the $170M Series C with Avenir (Mar 2021, $1B+); $250M Series D at $3B+ (Feb 2022); no IPO yet.
Healthcare payments platform (Cedar Cares, Inc., 32 6th Ave, New York); Tiger Global co-led the $200M Series D at $3.2B (Mar 2021) with Kinnevik; still independent.
New York metabolic-health and GLP-1 program (Calibrate Health, Inc., site live with 2026 copyright); Tiger Global led the ~$100M Series B after the seed-era backers; valuation not disclosed.
São Paulo ride-hailing app (ex-99Taxis); Monashees and Qualcomm Ventures funded the 2013 seed, Tiger Global led the Series A (Feb 2015, PE Hub/TechCrunch); DiDi bought the rest in Jan 2018.
Beijing parent of TikTok/Douyin (Cayman-incorporated); Tiger Global could only have entered in late private rounds or secondaries; buybacks and rounds value it at ~$300B+ (2024-2025); still private.
Boston SaaS-buying platform (YC S19); vendr.com: Tiger Global led the $60M Series A (2021), then Craft and SoftBank co-led a $150M Series B at $1B (2022); acquired by Vertice (announced 1 June 2026).
Jakarta edtech; Tiger Global led the $55M round (Apr 2021) that followed the $150M Series C (Dec 2019, General Atlantic/GGV); no priced valuation of $1B+ disclosed.

Belfast package-management SaaS ('Made with love in Belfast'); Tiger Global led the $15M Series A (2021) after Frontline/Techstart/MMC seed money; TCV led later rounds incl. a $72M Series C; valuation undisclosed.
